newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Amersham seeks 975 mln stg facility for merger.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Amersham seeks 975 mln stg facility for merger.

text.p: LONDON July 3, (LPC) - Joint arrangers Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Citibank said they have been mandated to arrange a 975 million stg five-year revolving credit guarantee and sterling acceptance facility for Amersham International Plc plc, which has been fully underwritten.
The transaction funds Amersham's merger with Norwegian group Nycomed ASA.

The deal is the second Amersham facility to be announced this week. DMG is also sub-underwriting a 350 million stg facility which will fund the merger of Amersham's Life Science business with Pharmacia Biotech.

Top-level syndication of this deal will continue, however the syndication strategy has been altered to take account of the newly-announced merger, and sub-underwriters will now fund the transaction without recourse to general syndication.

The 975 million stg transaction is also out to sub-underwriters. Banks faced with funding 1.325 billion stg of Amersham debt in parallel syndications said that company exposure could be a short-term problem. But sources said the commercial logic behind the mergers looks likely to ensure satisfactory uptake of the two transactions.

The issue is expected to be resolved by October, when the 350 million stg facility will be refinanced by the 975 million stg facility, if the merger receives regulatory approval. If the deal encounters regulatory problems, the 350 million stg facility will proceed to general syndication on a stand-alone basis.
